summary: The Automation Templates page lists job and workflow job templates in a compact view with name, type and last run, sortable and searchable (alphanumeric search only), with launch, edit and duplicate actions; workflow templates show a visualizer icon.
questions: Where can I see all job templates in AAP?
Why does template search not find names with special characters?
How do I duplicate a job template?
How do I open the workflow visualizer from the templates list?
